ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Exactly three permanent surfaces — toolbar, canvas+status chips, inspector (source/index.html:11-79) — each tied to the job; toolbar buttons carry kbd equivalents (index.html:16-28) and disable when inapplicable (app.js:233-234, visible dimmed in both screenshots). accessibility.evidence: a11y.target_size pass, but a11y.contrast=fail and a11y.focus_order=skipped plus type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Source shows semantic ARIA (index.html:12,35,49,56,83) yet the global keydown handler intercepts Tab with preventDefault unconditionally (app.js:509), making toolbar buttons unreachable by keyboard; several permanent readouts under 11px (styles.css:129 card coord 9.5px; styles.css:88 zone-count 10.5px; styles.css:170 insp-label 10.5px).

frontend_rework.evidence: Receipt implies rework: layout.responsive_collision=fail, a11y.contrast=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json; layout.overflow and text.truncation pass, no gross visual defects in screenshots). Additional source defects: help documents full-width ＋/＝/－ zoom keys (app.js:61-62) while the handler only matches ASCII + = - _ (app.js:517-518); startEdit's blur handler references undeclared `id`, so blur-commit can never fire (app.js:375).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 'spatial operations have keyboard equivalents' is comprehensively addressed: KEYCONTRACTS table enumerates every spatial op with keys (app.js:36-67), rendered as the help layer visible in both screenshots; all implemented in the keydown switch (app.js:492-531: N create, Tab select, arrows nudge/pan same 20px grid as drag, 1/2/3 zone placement, [ ] z-order, Del, Ctrl+Z, F focus, +/-/0 zoom/reset); toolbar mirrors the same actions with kbd hints (index.html:16-28). Only blemish is the full-width vs ASCII glyph mismatch on zoom keys.

scores.overall_note: impl-16 is a faithful spatial-workspace build for a create×spatial job: a canvas-dominant board of three physical zones where placement itself carries meaning (center-point zone membership, live reassignment, grid snap, proximity readouts — app.js:99-106, 337, 459), reachable in one step from load, with no context-losing navigation. The acceptance seed is the app's explicit spine: a generated key-contract layer (visible in both screenshots) documents every spatial operation, and the keydown switch implements them, so keyboard equivalence coverage is essentially complete. The deductions are quality-side: the receipt records three failures (responsive collision, contrast, minimum projected type size) plus a skipped focus-order check; the source adds a global Tab interception that locks toolbar buttons out of keyboard traversal, sub-11px readouts, a full-width vs ASCII zoom-key legend mismatch, and a dead blur-commit handler; and both captured initial screenshots show the help modal covering the workspace even though the source initializes it hidden, so the captured first screen does not lead with the canvas. Error-rate and token figures are operator data outside blind scope; no arm or build-process inference is made.
